searchText: I'm so sorry, completely forgot to send this through on the weekend <@340345049063882753>!! https://lab.ethpandaops.io/ethereum/consensus/overview?t=90d#reorg-chart This might be a little noisy though because its fed from all 100-150 xatu nodes. Is there any metric in particular that you were looking for? That's exactly what I wanted. Folks were trying to tell me there was a 5+ block reorg on sepolia and I refused to believe it. I'm pretty sure it was actually the consensus-aware proxy that wound up effectively truncating the chain rather than an actual reorg.
